Write a concise, useful checklist
**Quick‑Start Productivity Checklist**  
*(Print or copy into your favorite notes app and tick off each item as you go.)*

---

### 1️⃣ Start‑of‑Day Prep  
- [ ] Review today’s top 3 priorities (the “must‑do” items).  
- [ ] Check calendar for meetings, deadlines, and buffer times.  
- [ ] Set a clear, realistic goal for the day (e.g., “Finish draft of report”).  

### 2️⃣ Focus & Execution  
- [ ] Block uninterrupted work periods (e.g., 90‑minute “deep‑work” slots).  
- [ ] Use the Pomodoro technique (25 min work / 5 min break) for tasks >30 min.  
- [ ] Tackle the most challenging task first (Eat the Frog).  

### 3️⃣ Communication  
- [ ] Respond to urgent emails/messages (≤15 min).  
- [ ] Send a brief status update to any stakeholders if needed.  
- [ ] Schedule any required follow‑up meetings before the day ends.  

### 4️⃣ Progress Check  
- [ ] Review completed items against the top 3 priorities.  
- [ ] Note any blockers and assign next‑step owners.  
- [ ] Update task tracker or project board.  

### 5️⃣ End‑of‑Day Wrap‑Up  
- [ ] Clear your inbox to “zero” or flag for tomorrow.  
- [ ] Write tomorrow’s top 3 priorities.  
- [ ] Shut down computer, turn off notifications, and log off.  

### 6️⃣ Personal Well‑Being (quick reminders)  
- [ ] Take at least one 5‑minute stretch or walk break.  
- [ ] Drink water (aim for 2 L total).  
- [ ] Log a brief gratitude note or win of the day.  

---

**Tip:** Keep this checklist visible on your desk or as a phone widget. Checking off each line gives a small dopamine boost and keeps you on track!
